description: Recent SEC filings for <ticker> — the company's latest EDGAR filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K). Returns filing type, report period, filing date, and document URL. Optionally filter by filing_type. Example: fd_filings({ ticker: "AAPL", filing_type: "8-K", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-key" })
name: fd_filings
